description: ground-Rydberg analog qubit — The computational states of an analog Rydberg machine are the ground and Rydberg levels, not hyperfine ground states. enc_hf is the hyperfine ground-state qubit and does not describe them.
proposal: New station enc_gr on atom_rb and atom_ae, with the Rydberg lifetime rather than the hyperfine coherence as its headline attribute.

description: optical clock-transition qubit — A 1S0-3P0 optical clock qubit is neither hyperfine nor nuclear-spin, and its coherence (10-100 ms) is three orders below every other occupant of enc_hf because it is laser-linewidth-limited.
proposal: New station enc_clock on atom_ae, carrying the laser-linewidth limit as an explicit attribute.

description: no encoding layer (analog and sampling machines) — Annealers and Gaussian-boson-sampling machines have no L2 object at all. The anneal path already declares an empty L2; leaving it implicit makes the gap read as an omission rather than a decision.
proposal: A shared enc_none sentinel so "no encoding" is a recorded choice, reachable from anneal and ph_cv.

description: multimode single-device dual rail — OQC's Dimon is one fixed-frequency device with three islands and two junctions operated as a dual-rail qubit. The transmon node describes a two-level anharmonic oscillator and cannot express a multimode single-device rail pair.
proposal: New carrier station multimode_transmon on dualrail, or a mode-count attribute on transmon.

description: resonator-induced-phase / parametric all-microwave 2Q on fluxonium — Not cross-resonance (g_cr) and not a flux-tunable coupler (g_tc): a fixed-coupling, all-microwave parametric gate on low-frequency qubits.
proposal: New station g_rip on sc, listing fluxonium as its native carrier.

description: gate mechanism not published — Nine deployed or shipping machines publish no entangling-gate name, time or fidelity. Assigning the nearest node silently manufactures a fact.
proposal: A g_undisclosed sentinel so the register can distinguish "we do not know" from "there is none".

description: analog Rydberg Hamiltonian evolution — g_ryd is a discrete blockade CZ; g_anneal is an rf-SQUID flux annealer. Neither describes a programmable Rydberg Ising quench with global drive and local detuning.
proposal: New station g_rydanalog on atom_rb and atom_ae.

description: global analog Ising evolution in a 2-D ion crystal — A 512-ion Coulomb crystal driven globally is an analog simulator on an ion carrier. g_ms is a discrete entangling gate.
proposal: New station g_isingcrystal on ion_qccd, paired with the L4 gap below.

description: no entangling gate demonstrated — The largest atom array in the world has no two-qubit operation. A register that defaults to g_ryd here silently promotes it to a gate-model machine.
proposal: A g_none sentinel, distinct from g_undisclosed.

description: programmable linear-optical interferometer with no entangling primitive — Sampling machines have a gate layer with nothing gate-like in it. g_fusion implies a heralded Bell measurement they never perform; g_cv implies feed-forward they do not have.
proposal: New station g_lo_sampling on ph_cv and ph_fusion.

description: central computational bus resonator — A shared multi-qubit resonator giving all-to-all inside a cell is neither a static nearest-neighbour lattice (cx_nn) nor point-to-point long-range couplers (cx_lr). This is the clearest single-node gap the Map has at L4 for superconducting.
proposal: New station cx_busres on sc, with cell size and bus-mode count as attributes.

description: optical-lattice conveyor transport — cx_aod is explicitly AOD tweezer moves of hundreds of micrometres in 0.4-1.6 ms. A half-metre conveyor belt carrying 300,000 atoms per second is a different mechanism and is the enabler for indefinite-depth atom computing.
proposal: New station cx_conveyor on atom_rb and atom_ae.

description: optical-lattice site grid with sequential reloading — A lattice-held register with no per-atom moves has no Map node; cx_aod presumes tweezer transport.
proposal: New station cx_lattice on atom_ae.

description: static 2-D Coulomb crystal, power-law all-to-all — Neither cx_bus (1-D chain modes) nor cx_qccd (shuttling) describes a static 2-D crystal with power-law coupling and no transport.
proposal: New station cx_crystal on ion_qccd.

description: optical any-to-any link used as the connectivity layer — Entanglement-First collapses L4 and L9 into one physical mechanism. The defect path forces cx_nn at L4, which inverts the architecture's central claim.
proposal: New station cx_optlink on defect, plus permission for one node to occupy two layers.

description: out-of-plane vertical signal delivery — Coaxmon, VIO and perpendicular wiring are all still room-temperature electronics, so the Map cannot distinguish them from a coax-per-qubit machine - yet this is precisely the axis on which they compete.
proposal: New station ct_vio on sc and dualrail, with lines-per-qubit and routing-layer count as attributes.

description: free-space AOM/AOD laser addressing for ions — ct_ionlaser is in-trap waveguide delivery; ct_ionmw is laser-free microwave. The single most common ion control stack in the world - a room-temperature optical bench with multi-channel acousto-optic addressing - has no node.
proposal: New station ct_ionaod on ion_qccd and ion_elec.

description: room-temperature microwave and optical spin control — The defect path assigns ct_base (voltage pulses on gates), which describes quantum-dot and Majorana control, not NV control by microwave drive, green-laser initialisation and optical readout.
proposal: New station ct_nvopt on defect.

description: calibration and frequency choreography — Snake optimisation, ABAA junction trimming, post-fab laser trimming and PALEA all occupy the same architectural slot and all move measured error by multiples. dec_rl covers only reinforcement learning inside a QEC loop.
proposal: A ct_calib station, or a calibration-regime attribute on every L5 node.

description: control stack undisclosed — A vendor with a nine-figure Series A discloses no ion species, qubit count, gate mechanism or control architecture.
proposal: Reuse the undisclosed sentinel pattern at every layer rather than forcing a nearest node.

description: qubits and controller on one die — ct_cryocmos describes a separate ASIC at 4 K or 7 mK. A single 22FDX die carrying qubits and controller at 0.3 K with no dilution refrigerator is a different object.
proposal: A co-integration attribute on ct_cryocmos (separate-ASIC / same-die) plus the operating temperature.

description: leakage-reduction units — Google's DQLR needs four dedicated leakage-removal qubits and extra DC lines; USTC's all-microwave LRU needs neither. This is the single biggest technical difference between the only two below-threshold superconducting memories in existence, and it has no station.
proposal: New station ro_lru on sc, or a sub-layer L6b for in-cycle state-hygiene operations.

description: fast unconditional or dissipative reset — Reset is a per-cycle cost term in every surface-code budget. Nighthawk r2's high-dynamic-range coupler to a cold bath, USTC's in-cycle ancilla reset and Google's 160 ns reset have no station.
proposal: New station ro_reset on sc, cat and dualrail, with reset time and residual population as attributes.

description: homodyne quadrature detection with a shared local oscillator — ro_spd (SNSPD/TES photon counting) is the heralding path of a CV machine, not its computational readout. The ph_cv path currently has no correct L6.
proposal: New station ro_homodyne on ph_cv.

description: QFP / SQUID flux readout through on-chip shift registers — The anneal path assigns ro_disp, which describes transmon dispersive readout with a parametric amplifier. D-Wave does not read out that way.
proposal: New station ro_flux on anneal.

description: no code (NISQ) — Eighty-seven of the 136 machines carry no code station of any kind - they run no QEC code at all. The Map forces either a false code claim or a blank cell.
proposal: A code_none sentinel on every path, so "no code" is distinguishable from "not yet recorded".

description: error mitigation as the occupant of the code slot — ZNE, PEC and tensor-network post-processing are what actually occupy the code slot on every NISQ machine and on all three IBM July-2026 advantage claims. It is not error correction, but it is not nothing.
proposal: New station code_mitig on sc, atom_rb and ion paths, explicitly flagged as non-correcting.

description: error-detection-only codes on the sc path — sc slot 7 lists only correcting codes. [[4,2,2]], d=2 surface, [[4,1,2]] and the IBM/UChicago spacetime code are detection codes and are what shipped.
proposal: Add the detection family to sc slot 7, or a detect-vs-correct attribute on each code node.

description: distillation-free analog rotation by direct injection — STAR's whole point is avoiding magic-state distillation: arbitrary-angle rotations are injected directly and carry residual error by design. The Map has no station for that trade.
proposal: New station code_analogrot on sc and atom_ae.

description: path-membership gap for qLDPC — SHYPS on defect, generalized-bicycle Pinnacle on spin_qd and honeycomb-Floquet on topo are all named codes for platforms whose L7 slot lists cannot reach them.
proposal: Extend the slot lists rather than adding nodes: code_qldpc on defect, spin_qd and topo; honeycomb_floquet on topo.
resolution: partly: `code_qldpc` added to the defect and spin_qd slots (diraq-imec-8q, photonic-inc) on 26 Sep 2026; the honeycomb Floquet code on topo remains a gap

description: toric versus rotated surface code — code_surface is the rotated surface code. Atom Computing ran the periodic-boundary toric code; the boundary condition changes the qubit count and the logical operator structure.
proposal: A boundary attribute on code_surface, or promote the existing toric code id to its own station.

description: subsystem codes have no fitting station — Bacon-Shor is a subsystem code with weight-2 checks, cheap on a single ion chain. code_highrate is described as concatenated and high-rate, which Bacon-Shor is not.
proposal: New station code_subsystem on ion_qccd and sc.

description: no decoder, and no deployment-mode axis — The L8 nodes name algorithms, not whether the decoder runs in-loop, streaming or offline. That distinction is the whole difference between Google's below-threshold memory and USTC's, and between IBM's Relay-BP benchmark and a QEC loop.
proposal: A dec_none sentinel plus a mandatory mode attribute (in-loop / streaming / offline / replay) on every dec_* node.

description: real-time lookup-table decoder — The longest-running in-loop decoder on any platform - Quantinuum since 2021 - is a table lookup. No dec_* node covers it.
proposal: New station dec_lut on ion_qccd.

description: block decoder for concatenated high-rate codes — Quantinuum's Frontier is neither matching, nor belief propagation, nor a GPU platform layer: it is a block-specific decoder for concatenated codes.
proposal: New station dec_block on ion_qccd and ion_elec.

description: search decoder for qLDPC — Beam search (Delfosse) decoded nine codes on one ion device. The Map's L8 set has no search decoder.
proposal: New station dec_search on ion_elec and sc.

description: coherent, measurement-free decoding — The syndrome is mapped into an ancilla register and corrected by a unitary. Every dec_* node presumes a classical decoder and a latency; this one is latency-free by construction.
proposal: New station dec_coherent on ion_qccd, flagged as removing the classical reaction time from the FT loop.

description: autonomous stabilisation and analog decoding — Nord Quantique runs no classical decoder at all, and GKP decoding is a closest-vector problem over an analog syndrome. The cat path's only decoder is dec_mwpm, which is wrong for these machines.
proposal: New station dec_analog on cat and ph_cv.

description: monolithic, single module — Ninety-eight of the 136 machines have no interconnect at all. ic_mcm, ic_cryolink and ic_transducer all assert something untrue of them.
proposal: An ic_none sentinel, so "no link" is distinguishable from "link not yet classified".

description: multi-die packaging inside one qubit module — An aluminium die flip-chipped to a tantalum die, or a qubit wafer bump-bonded to a control wafer, is materials partitioning, not chiplet tiling into one lattice. ic_mcm means the latter.
proposal: New station ic_multidie on sc, cat and dualrail.

description: inter-module matter link — Ion transfer between separate trap chips at 2,424 transfers per second with loss infidelity below 7e-8 is peer-reviewed and demonstrated. ic_ionphoton is photonic; cx_qccd is intra-module.
proposal: New station ic_ionmatter on ion_elec and ion_qccd.

description: the spin paths have no L9 slot at all — Intel's Pando Tree (a mK signal router fanning out to 64 channels), Hitachi's 3-D stacked cryo-wiring and Equal1's QSoC are all interconnect-layer artefacts, and multi-chip spin modules sit on three roadmaps.
proposal: Open an L9 slot on spin_qd and spin_donor, and add an ic_router station for on-chip signal fan-out.

description: inter-core link, mechanism undisclosed — Three multi-core machines describe cores without describing what joins them; a dual-isotope design hints at species-selective addressing rather than a link at all.
proposal: The undisclosed sentinel again, with a required "mechanism" field once disclosed.

description: bulk-optics and fibre-assembly photonic manufacturing — fab_pic is a 300 mm PIC foundry and fab_optics is scoped to the ion and atom paths. The machines holding the sampling records are built neither way.
proposal: Extend fab_optics to ph_cv and ph_fusion, or add fab_bulk.

description: Si-28 colour-centre plus silicon-photonics co-fabrication — fab_diamond is diamond-only; fab_pic sits on the photonic paths. T centres are a silicon-foundry product and the defect path cannot say so.
proposal: New station fab_sicolour on defect.

description: one machine needs two L10 nodes — A quantum-dot single-photon source is an MBE III-V product and its interferometer mesh is a SiN PIC. The schema allows one primary per layer.
proposal: Allow multiple primaries at L10, or a composite fab node with named sub-processes.

description: cryogenic plant and thermal budget — Cooling power at millikelvin, wall power, wiring cross-section, footprint, mass and serviceability are first-order scaling constraints - two jointly cooled 2.75 cubic-metre cryostats at 32 uW and 30 kW per module, a 40 kW cat-qubit cabinet, a 3 kW cryogenics-free atom rack, a 1,600 W self-cooled spin server, 30 W per photonic cabinet at 2 K - and the Map has no layer for any of it.
proposal: Open an eleventh layer, plant, with stations for dilution refrigerator, 4 K pulse-tube, sub-kelvin cryogen-free, liquid-helium circulation and room-temperature vacuum, keyed by cooling power, wall power and lines per qubit.

description: codes with no stage-1 id — Three code families that carry real hardware results still have no id in the stage-1 register: Iceberg [[n,n-2,2]] (Quantinuum Helios, up to 94 error-detected logical qubits), the carbon code (Quantinuum H2) and C4-Helix (the [[20,2,6]] concatenation on Helios). Two more were closed in Sep 2026: css_4_1_2 and spacetime_circuit are now stage-1 ids and the machines that ran them carry them.
proposal: Add the remaining three to the codes register with their measured instances, or record explicitly why they are out of scope.

description: no record key for single-qubit gate error — The Map's 27 record keys carry t1q (single-qubit gate time) and err_2q_parallel, but no key for single-qubit gate error. Five machines publish a 1Q infidelity as their headline control number and it has nowhere to go: Helios 2.5e-5, QUARTET 1.5e-7 (unshielded), IBEX Q1 3.4e-4, Caltech 2e-4, SQC 1e-4.
proposal: Add an err_1q record key alongside err_2q_parallel, so a 1Q infidelity is not filed under a time key.
